authorship: Independent agent reviewer; not human trader sign-off. No exposed baseline questions were read while authoring these cases.

data_policy.source: Bind actual captured Public SPY/IBM/QQQ evidence before either arm; freeze input JSON and hashes.
forbidden: Tune questions or rubric after candidate output.
Turn receipt time into observation time.
data_policy.projection: Subsets/omissions of real facts are allowed and must be recorded; values, source times and quality remain unchanged.
data_policy.control_fixture: alert_store_error declares an injected read-status error, not an assertion that the real store failed.
data_policy.prerequisites: stale_or_unknown and unknown_chain require real matching quality; selected_expiry/uncovered_expiry require an exact valid frozen selection; compatible_pair requires two actual compatible observations. Missing prerequisites => not_assessable, never fabrication.
data_policy.families: price_without_flip omits flip facts; no_alerts has explicit successful-empty read; no_vol omits volatility; no_company omits news/event facts; no_history has one snapshot; price_without_option_quote contains no option quotes. Other profiles use available real named-ticker facts.

evaluation.not_a_claim: Functional coverage, not trading skill or statistical superiority.
